meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成 GitHub PR 的代码讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要向同事或客户解释代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn a GitHub PR into a code-change explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain code changes to non-technical stakeholders

howto.what: 当你把一个 GitHub 改动（PR）交给 Claude，它会读取这次改动的差异、提交和文件，产出代码变更讲解视频，涵盖变更日志、功能展示、修复或重构说明，并生成脚本、画面帧和 mp4 视频文件。
howto.when: 当你提供 PR 的 URL、owner/repo#N，或在已检出仓库中说“这个 PR”，并要求做成视频时触发。意图不明确时走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 用 owner/repo#123 做讲解视频
say.note: 会读取该 PR 并生成视频。

say.text: 把这个 PR 做成功能展示视频
say.note: 需在已检出仓库中，并明确指代当前 PR。

say.text: 把 owner/repo#456 做成修复说明视频
say.note: 将基于该 PR 生成修复讲解。

howto.what_en: When given a GitHub pull request, Claude reads its diff, commits, and files, then produces an explainer video covering changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough, ending with script, frame files, and an mp4 render.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user supplies a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo and asks for a video. Uncertain intents route to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Make an explainer video for owner/repo#123
say_en.note: Reads that PR and generates the video.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into a feature reveal
say_en.note: Use in a checked-out repo pointing to the PR.

say_en.text: Turn owner/repo#456 into a fix explainer
